newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kingstream says An Feng merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Kingstream says An Feng merger approved.

text.p: Kingstream Resources NL said on Thursday the Australian government did not have any objections under foreign policy guidelines to its merger proposal with Taiwan's An Feng Steel Co Ltd.
The merger of the two companies, which plan to build the A$1.4 billion Midwest Iron and Steel project in Western Australia, was announced in early January 1997.

"This is a significant step in the proposed merger approval process and confirms the commitment and support of the Australian government to ensuring major development projects with significant downstream value added benefits," Kingstream said.
The steel-making project has an annual production target of 2.4 million tonnes of steel slab a year.
The companies plan to begin construction in the 1997 third quarter.
